\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 168-171 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R176-first-pass-words-from-chapters-168-171}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for less and a difference.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an arm, the body, an ankle, the throat, a headache
  \item a mood, an exercise, fitness, an injury, a pill
  \item early, daily, a delay, late, never
  \item the future, a period, a beginning, rarely, often
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An arm? (\textbf{\ar{ذراع}}, \emph{dhirāʿ}.) The body? (\textbf{\ar{جسم}}, \emph{jism}.) An ankle? (\textbf{\ar{كاحل}}, \emph{kāḥil}.) The throat? (\textbf{\ar{حلق}}, \emph{ḥalq}.) A headache? (\textbf{\ar{صداع}}, \emph{ṣudāʿ}.) A mood? (\textbf{\ar{مزاج}}, \emph{mizāj}.) An exercise? (\textbf{\ar{تمرين}}, \emph{tamrīn}.) Fitness? (\textbf{\ar{لياقة}}, \emph{liyāqa}.) An injury? (\textbf{\ar{إصابة}}, \emph{iṣāba}.) A pill? (\textbf{\ar{حبة}}, \emph{ḥabba}.) Early? (\textbf{\ar{مبكرا}}, \emph{mubakkiran}.) Daily? (\textbf{\ar{يوميا}}, \emph{yawmiyyan}.) A delay? (\textbf{\ar{تأخير}}, \emph{taʾkhīr}.) Late? (\textbf{\ar{متأخرا}}, \emph{mutaʾakhkhiran}.) Never? (\textbf{\ar{أبدا}}, \emph{abadan}.) The future? (\textbf{\ar{مستقبل}}, \emph{mustaqbal}.) A period? (\textbf{\ar{مدة}}, \emph{mudda}.) A beginning? (\textbf{\ar{بداية}}, \emph{bidāya}.) Rarely? (\textbf{\ar{نادرا}}, \emph{nādiran}.) Often? (\textbf{\ar{كثيرا}}, \emph{kathīran}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 172-176 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R176-second-pass-words-from-chapters-172-176}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a living room and a bakery.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a living room, a bakery, a café, a direction, opposite
  \item an orchard, a tent, a car park; a stop, a continent, a volcano
  \item a reason, a result, therefore, so, so that
  \item friendship, society, hospitality, despite, also
  \item then, while, more, less, a difference
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A living room? (\textbf{\ar{صالة}}, \emph{ṣāla}.) A bakery? (\textbf{\ar{مخبز}}, \emph{makhbaz}.) A café? (\textbf{\ar{مقهى}}, \emph{maqhā}.) A direction? (\textbf{\ar{اتجاه}}, \emph{ittijāh}.) Opposite? (\textbf{\ar{مقابل}}, \emph{muqābil}.) An orchard? (\textbf{\ar{بستان}}, \emph{bustān}.) A tent? (\textbf{\ar{خيمة}}, \emph{khayma}.) A car park; a stop? (\textbf{\ar{موقف}}, \emph{mawqif}.) A continent? (\textbf{\ar{قارة}}, \emph{qārra}.) A volcano? (\textbf{\ar{بركان}}, \emph{burkān}.) A reason? (\textbf{\ar{سبب}}, \emph{sabab}.) A result? (\textbf{\ar{نتيجة}}, \emph{natīja}.) Therefore? (\textbf{\ar{لذلك}}, \emph{li-dhālika}.) So? (\textbf{\ar{إذن}}, \emph{idhan}.) So that? (\textbf{\ar{كي}}, \emph{kay}.) Friendship? (\textbf{\ar{صداقة}}, \emph{ṣadāqa}.) Society? (\textbf{\ar{مجتمع}}, \emph{mujtamaʿ}.) Hospitality? (\textbf{\ar{ضيافة}}, \emph{ḍiyāfa}.) Despite? (\textbf{\ar{رغم}}, \emph{raghma}.) Also? (\textbf{\ar{أيضا}}, \emph{ayḍan}.) Then? (\textbf{\ar{ثم}}, \emph{thumma}.) While? (\textbf{\ar{بينما}}, \emph{baynamā}.) More? (\textbf{\ar{أكثر}}, \emph{akthar}.) Less? (\textbf{\ar{أقل}}, \emph{aqall}.) A difference? (\textbf{\ar{فرق}}, \emph{farq}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
